title: Prototype Add-on uploaded to addons.thunderbird.net, "approved", but remains unsigned
creator: morrisqc
content:
Add-on Trencher (prototype), ID trencher@lexscripta.com, version 0.1.4, submitted through the Developer Hub on the self-distribution channel.

Status on Manage Versions & Status: Approved, with file 1055710 (All Platforms) marked Approved on 17 November.

The download is offered at: https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/downloads/file/1055710/trencher_prototype-0.1.4-tb.xpi

However, this download returns 19,120 bytes in three different browsers, byte-for-byte identical to the file that was uploaded, and containing no META-INF directory and no signature block. The only apparent change is adding "-tb" to the file name.

Downloaded and installed, Thunderbird refuses it: it is an unsigned package, and the client enforces signatures.

Where is the signed artefact made available to the developer, if not at that link?
